audit_result.proof_trace: The catch block at L54-57 returns null unconditionally for all error types — including 404 (not found), 429 (rate limit), and 5xx (server/network errors) — without inspecting error.status or error.code. This collapses two semantically distinct failure modes into a single null return, breaking the property. The most impactful consequence is in memberStatus.ts:L18-27, where a null from an API error causes the endpoint to respond with is_in_server: false, falsely reporting a valid member as absent from the server.
audit_result.attack_scenario: If the Discord API becomes transiently unavailable (rate limit, network failure, or outage), calls to GET /api/member/status return is_in_server: false for legitimate members; any downstream access-control logic relying on this field would incorrectly deny or revoke access for those members.

PROP-stem-bot-v21-inv-014.text: getMember errors must distinguish not-found from API failure; not silently return null for both.
PROP-stem-bot-v21-inv-014.assertion: forall uid: getMember(uid) error => error_type in {NOT_FOUND, API_ERROR}, not null
